claim.value: The per-revision signal comprises the number tested, the fraction exceeding one hour and its uncertainty, accompanied by workload and load records.
claim.scope: Specified observational basis for revision classification.

provenance.rationale: P016 supplies all stated signal quantities and accompanying records.

signal_basis.value: Repeated representative exports are tested at a revision, recording the trial count, fraction exceeding one hour, uncertainty, workload and load.
signal_basis.scope: Per-revision observations used for the prescribed good, bad or inconclusive classification.

provenance.rationale: P011 specifies repeated representative trials; P016 specifies their recorded signal; P017 identifies its classification use.
This supported observational specification requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Given the assumed execution and observed signal, the claim directly describes the prescribed observations. It asserts no further inference about classification accuracy, causality or deployment safety.
uncertainty: No material uncertainty about warrant within this descriptive scope.
